implements_gap: K01 D3(a)/(c) cross-run prefix stability and D8 real cache effectiveness (decision D1): system prefix currently carries persona + owner memory + run-start route/skills notice, and the summary is the first user message, so content-address providers (Anthropic/DeepSeek/Gemini) never match across runs when memories/route/skills/summary change. This batch records the verified drift sources, the P1-a/b/c/d layout options (P1-a recommended: persona-only system, memory/summary blocks at fixed positions, route/skills moved to the tail), the semantics risks, byte-stability tests, and the D8 isolated-provider experiment design. NOT implementation: no source/test/migration/route/worker change
verified_facts: domain/metering.py:43-53 memory_system = persona + optional owner-memory JSON (memory_id/revision/kind/content, captured and not erased) + notice; history_request:56-73 puts the summary as the first user message and then history

application/engine.py:345-359 initial_notice = route_notice(mode, has request_mode) + skills.notice(...) goes into the system via extra_notice; tail_notice = todo_notice + reflection_notice goes to the tail

application/context.py:92-101 prepare passes extra_notice to the system and tail_notice via append_runtime_notice; domain/turn_prompt.py:28-44 TurnPrompt keeps the captured system byte-frozen for the run and appends changed notices to the tail

drift sources into the system: owner memory changes (new/decay/erase), run-start route mode, captured/activated skills notice, persona edits (low frequency); summary drift starts right after the system message
K06 compact_run compresses old tool rounds into one bounded user summary and does not change the system/head/recent rounds or content_epoch
D3(b) already shipped (372ad56d): pc_<sha256(agent|session|epoch)[:24]> only for slot-keyed/OpenAI extra_body; content-address providers rely on byte parity
decision_questions: P1 layout: P1-a persona-only system + fixed memory/summary blocks + route/skills tail (recommended) / P1-b hybrid stable-memory snapshot / P1-c minimal (notices+summary only) / P1-d keep current
P2 memory block: position, size bound, deletion barrier, no importance/clarity exposure; fixed header and field order
P3 route/skills notices: unify with append_runtime_notice tail ordering (route -> skills -> todo -> reflection), truncation
P4 summary position relative to the memory block and history
P5 rollout: global code switch vs per-agent setting (settings KEYS/schema + A coordination); rollback probe keeps old assembly internally

P6 D8: isolated provider/key, same model/session consecutive runs, measure cache hit/creation tokens and cost from existing usage fields; only D3(b) as the baseline control; never in the default offline suite
semantics_risks: owner memory drops from system (high salience) to a data block after the system message
route/skills guidance moves from system to tail, which may reduce immediate adherence; owner real-model review required
persona edits intentionally change the system and therefore the cache bucket
erased/forgotten memories must never appear in the memory block
